transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-10-07 | Start: 15:00 PDT | Duration: 52m
Attendees: Ethan Mercer (Redwood AE), Priya Shah (Redwood SE), Carlos Vega (Redwood CSM), Dr. Maya Bennett (CTO, Lumos), Arjun Patel (Lead ML Eng, Lumos), Sofia Li (DevOps, Lumos)

Summary: Kickoff to align on technical onboarding, success criteria, security requirements, and next steps for Lumos Health migrating inference to Redwood.

00:00 Ethan Mercer: hey everyone thanks for joining, um quick intro from our side, i'm ethan i'm the account exec, priya is our solutions eng who will lead the tech onboarding, carlos on CS 
00:12 Dr. Maya Bennett: thanks ethan, excited to get started, we ran the cal, so appreciate you moving quickly
00:20 Priya Shah: hi all, i'll outline the runbook and what we need from you - infra checklist, sample workloads, and a short bench that we'll run as part of the pilot
00:35 Arjun Patel: quick context — we're running a mix of 3 models atm, a 7b open model and a finetuned 13b for summarization, avg sequence len is around 280 tokens, p95 latency goal is 350ms, peak qps ~18 during business hours
00:54 Priya Shah: great, that helps; so options are: hosted (fastest to start), dedicated reserved capacity (predictable throughput), or private (VPC/on-prem) for later. for the pilot we usually start hosted or dedicated depending on data residency and security needs
01:15 Sofia Li: security is the big one, we are SOC2 in progress and need audit logs, KMS integration, and SSO for the team. we may look at private in phase 2, but for now want to see network peering and encryption in transit at minimum
01:32 Ethan Mercer: totally, we support SAML SSO, audit logs, and KMS integrations; priya i'll let you talk about the VPC peering approach and what we need from your infra team
01:45 Priya Shah: sure — for VPC peering we'll need two things: a VPC CIDR and a list of ACLs, also we have a documented step-by-step for peering, i'll share the link after the call. note, sometimes the transcription says "V P C" which is weird in the exports haha
02:08 Dr. Maya Bennett: haha, yeah i saw that in the sample notes, also how do you handle KV cache when switching between model variants? that was a question from our ML team
02:20 Priya Shah: so the runtime manages KV cache and we keep a per-session cache; sometimes wording in our docs says KV cash in older drafts — ignore that. performance wise we can tune cache warmup and batching to hit your p95. we'll propose quantization and batching profiles based on your sample traces
02:42 Arjun Patel: do you have any bench numbers for 13b on dedicated infra? we've seen other vendors show 450ms p95 but with heavy batching, which hurts tail latency for interactive users
02:55 Priya Shah: yes, on comparable GPUs our dedicated profiles typically hit 250-350ms p95 for 13b depending on sequence len and batch tuning. we can run a benchmark in your environment or run a synthetic bench from our dedicated pool as a proxy. we'll need your sample workload to be representative
03:17 Ethan Mercer: pricing note — we can talk about committed reserved capacity which lowers unit cost vs pay-as-you-go hosted. i'll send a short pricing summary after this call.
03:27 Sofia Li: on compliance, can you confirm retention windows and ability to disable data retention for specific routes? we need to map that to our data handling policy
03:40 Carlos Vega: yes you can toggle retention per-route, and we offer a private flag for PII-heavy traffic. priya will share the data flow doc and retention options link.
03:55 Dr. Maya Bennett: awesome. also curious about observability — we need token-level cost breakdowns and per-model latency traces to map to our billing and on-call alerts
04:10 Priya Shah: Redwood Console has per-route dashboards, token-level cost, and tracing hooks you can integrate with their existing observability stack. we'll set up access for your devops and SREs in the pilot
04:28 Arjun Patel: who typically owns the rollout? we have a small infra team — we want to avoid too much lift on our side
04:38 Carlos Vega: CS will own the onboarding cadence and act as the primary coordinator; SE and infra will work with your engineers on VPC, network, and test benchmarks. for rollouts we recommend canary -> ramp -> full migrate, and we provide fallback policies to hosted if capacity is constrained
04:58 Priya Shah: action wise: can you share a traffic profile (qps distribution, seq len percentiles) and a sample prompt set — even a small set of live-ish prompts is super helpful for quality checks
05:18 Arjun Patel: yes we'll compile that, probably export from our telemetry, target to share by monday 10/12
05:27 Ethan Mercer: perfect. i'm going to summarize next steps at the end but quick Q: timeline for pilot — do you want a 2-week bench or 4-week pilot?
05:38 Dr. Maya Bennett: prefer 2-week performance bench first, then a 4-week pilot if numbers look good; decision makers are myself and the product lead, procurement gets involved for dedicated capacity talks
05:52 Priya Shah: noted. we'll scope the 2-week bench: infra checklist -> bench run -> results -> follow-up to confirm if we move to pilot. i will include quantization suggestions and cost tradeoffs in the runbook
06:10 Sofia Li: network diagram will be helpful — i'll attach our current VPC schematic to the ticket. also need to confirm if you support customer-managed keys (HSM) later on
06:22 Priya Shah: we integrate with KMS and have options for HSM in private deployments — i'll call that out in the doc.
06:30 Ethan Mercer: ok let's do a quick recap of next steps and owners
06:36 Carlos Vega: Recap: Priya to share runbook + infra checklist (due 10/09); Ethan to share pricing + reserved capacity options (due 10/10); Lumos (Arjun/Sofia) to share traffic profile and network diagram (due 10/12); Carlos to schedule weekly onboarding cadence (due 10/08).
06:58 Dr. Maya Bennett: thanks all, looking forward to the runbook and bench
07:03 Ethan Mercer: thanks everyone, we'll follow up via email with links and the invites.

References / shared: Runbook link (will be shared): https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/runbook ; Security pack (link pending) ; Benchmark template: https://redwood.example.com/benchmarks/template.xlsx

End of transcript
